feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: The Rhine at Kaub, Germany, resumed its climb
entry.summary: Germany's federal gauge network measured the Rhine at Kaub at 58 centimetres on 29 October, up from 56 centimetres over the previous two days. — Sources: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung, Pegelonline gauge network, direct reading, 29 October 2026

entry.title: Singapore's haze held in the moderate band for a fourth consecutive day
entry.summary: Singapore's National Environment Agency recorded a 24-hour PSI of 69 to 78 across all five regions at 1pm local time, moderate everywhere for a fourth day running, the longest such run recorded this season. — Sources: National Environment Agency, Singapore, direct reading, 29 October 2026, 1pm SGT
